title: Signal: Lock file without a plugin API version
scope: A composer.lock file that declares a composer.lock that records no plugin API version.
limitations: It matches a composer.lock that records no plugin API version in the parsed composer.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A composer.lock that mentions a composer.lock that records no plugin API version in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
